paper.title_en: Gravitational wave interactions with matter: beyond quadrupolar perturbations
paper.abstract_en: Previous work has developed the theory of linearized gravitational wave (GW) interactions with matter using the Bondi-Sachs formalism, but with the perturbations restricted to be quadrupolar, i.e., the angular dependence is spherical harmonic with $\ell=2$. Here, the theory is extended to the case of GWs on a Minkowski background with general $\ell$. Formulas for the GW damping and heating effects are obtained for arbitrary $\ell\ge 2$. It is found that the effects are, generally, enhanced, and this suggests that it is unlikely that higher $\ell$-modes will be seen in GW observations of the post-merger signal of a binary neutron star merger, or of a core collapse supernova.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在Bondi-Sachs形式体系下将线性化引力波与物质相互作用的理论从四极扰动（ℓ=2）推广到任意ℓ≥2，推导了阻尼与加热效应的普适公式，属于广义相对论基础与引力波物理的实质性理论推进，理论深度与新颖性较高，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 引力波与物质的相互作用：超越四极扰动
decision.abstract_zh: 此前的工作利用Bondi-Sachs形式体系发展了线性化引力波（GW）与物质相互作用的理论，但其中扰动被限制为四极，即角依赖为$\ell=2$的球谐函数。本文将该理论推广到闵可夫斯基背景上具有一般$\ell$的引力波情形。对任意$\ell\ge 2$，给出了引力波阻尼与加热效应的公式。研究发现，这些效应一般而言被增强，这暗示着在双中子星并合后信号或核心坍缩超新星的引力波观测中，不太可能看到更高$\ell$模式。
